exposure: Urine Congo red dot test (CRDT) result
outcome: Composite adverse maternal outcomes (preeclampsia, postpartum hemorrhage, intensive care unit admission, maternal death)
Composite adverse neonatal outcomes (small for gestational age, preterm birth, 5-min Apgar score < 7, neonatal intensive care unit admission, neonatal death)
cohort: Asian women presenting from 20 weeks' gestation with new onset or pre-existing hypertension, new or pre-existing proteinuria, preeclampsia symptoms, or suspected preeclampsia-related fetal growth restriction or abnormal Doppler.
finding: The urine Congo red dot test (CRDT) demonstrated high positive predictive value but low negative predictive value for adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes in women with suspected preeclampsia, indicating limited utility for identifying those at low risk.
